tablet.notes:
• New Dock layout (Settings > Layout): Chats, Groups, Calls and Voicemail in a bar at the bottom, with the current one highlighted
• Calls and Voicemail now show the same icons at the top to move between screens
• Voicemail redone to match Google's Phone app: new icons, play bar, no Refresh button, gear for where to save and Ask before deleting
• Send a message opens the conversation straight away
